{{Event Infobox
| Name  = Council of Ghosts
| Image = Event-Ghosts.png
}} {{Small Card Infobox|Apparition}}
{{E|Council of Ghosts}} is an event found exclusively in [[Act 2]]. It is one of the events affected by {{Asc|15|Ascension}}.

== Options ==
{{Frame|Accept}} {{TS|positive||Receive 5}} {{Asc|15|(3)}} {{C|Apparition|Apparitions}}. {{TS|negative||Lose X Max HP.}}
* X is equal to 50% of the player's Max HP, rounded up.

{{Frame|Refuse}} Nothing happens.
<br>
<br>
You are then given the option to {{Frame|Leave}}.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote>
<div style="font-style:italic">As you continue your ascent, {{TS|purple|up|thick black smoke}} begins to billow out of the ground and walls around you, coalescing into three masked forms that start to speak.

<br>
{{TS||up|"Another puppet of }} {{TS|gold|up|Neow}} {{TS||up| I think."}}<br>
{{TS|red|shake|"AGREED! SHE ALWAYS MAKES THE FUNNEST TOYS!"}}


You notice an over-sized grin as the third addresses you.
"Ignore the others... Would you like a taste of our {{TS|gold|up|power?"}}</div>

{{Frame|Accept}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
{{TS|gold||"Excellent!"}}

As the ghostly shape speaks, you notice its large mouth opening wider and wider. {{TS|purple|up|Thick black smoke}} spews forth and envelops the room. You cannot see or breathe...


Just before you lose consciousness, the sensation stops.


Whatever those things were, they are gone now. You continue on, feeling rather {{TS|blue||hollow.}}</div>
</blockquote>

{{Frame|Refuse}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
"How disappointing..."<br>
{{TS||up|"You will join us sooner or later."}}<br>
{{TS|red|shake|"HA HA HA HAHAHA!"}}

The shapes fade away, leaving only the unnerving laughter ringing in your ears.
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>

== Trivia ==
* This event is internally called Ghosts.
* {{C|Apparition}} is internally called Ghostly.
* One of the few events that directly refer to [[Neow]], this event reveals she is female.
